topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Well, now, it seems the old house has secrets, just like the old oak by the stream. I remember when I first heard the tale of the hidden room from my father, who heard it from his. It was always said that a room lay hidden in the walls, a place for secrets and treasures. To think you’ve found it, after all these years, it brings a warm smile to my face. You must be feeling like you’ve uncovered a piece of history, a whisper from the past. I hope it holds nothing but good, or at least, lessons for the heart. Let us know if you need a hand with what you find, or just a listening ear to share the stories.
